items.model: This story is about Mia. Her dog ran away during a storm, and she couldn't find him. Then she posted a photo online and asked for help. In the end, a woman found the dog in her garden, and Mia thanked her with a cake.

items.q: Some people prefer working from home, while others prefer working in an office. Which do you prefer, and why?
items.model: I think working from home is better, for two reasons. First, I can save time because I don't have to commute. For example, I save about two hours every day. Second, I can focus better in a quiet place. So overall, I prefer working from home.

items.q: Is it better to live in a big city or in the countryside? Why?
items.model: I think living in a big city is better, for two reasons. First, there are more job opportunities. For example, many companies have their offices in the city. Second, public transportation is very convenient. So overall, I prefer living in a big city.

items.q: Should students wear school uniforms? Why or why not?
items.model: I think wearing school uniforms is better, for two reasons. First, students don't have to choose clothes every morning. For example, they can save time before school. Second, uniforms help students feel like a team. So overall, I prefer school uniforms.

items.q: Do you think it is better to travel alone or with friends? Why?
items.model: I think traveling with friends is better, for two reasons. First, it's more fun to share experiences. For example, we can talk about the food we tried. Second, it's safer to be with other people. So overall, I prefer traveling with friends.

items.q: For everyday shopping, is it better to use cash or cards? Why?
items.model: I think using cards is better, for two reasons. First, paying is faster. For example, I can just tap my card at the register. Second, I can easily check how much I spent. So overall, I prefer using cards.

items.q: Is it better to read books on paper or on a screen? Why?
items.model: I think reading on paper is better, for two reasons. First, my eyes don't get tired. For example, I can read for hours without a headache. Second, I remember the story better. So overall, I prefer paper books.

items.q: Should companies allow employees to choose their working hours? Why or why not?
items.model: I think flexible working hours are better, for two reasons. First, employees can avoid crowded trains. For example, they can start at ten instead of nine. Second, people work better when they feel less stressed. So overall, I prefer flexible hours.

items.q: Is it better to cook at home or to eat out? Why?
items.model: I think cooking at home is better, for two reasons. First, it's cheaper. For example, one restaurant meal costs as much as three home meals. Second, it's healthier because I choose the ingredients. So overall, I prefer cooking at home.

items.q: Should young children have their own smartphones? Why or why not?
items.model: I think waiting until they are older is better, for two reasons. First, children may spend too much time on games. For example, some kids play for hours every night. Second, they can see dangerous websites. So overall, I prefer that young children don't have smartphones.

items.q: Is it better to take one long vacation a year or several short ones? Why?
items.model: I think several short vacations are better, for two reasons. First, I can rest more often. For example, I can take a long weekend every few months. Second, it's easier to take short breaks at work. So overall, I prefer short vacations.

items.q: Should public transportation be free for everyone? Why or why not?
items.model: I think free public transportation is better, for two reasons. First, more people would leave their cars at home. For example, traffic in the city center would go down. Second, it would help people with low incomes. So overall, I prefer free public transportation.

items.q: Would you rather work for a large company or a small company? Why?
items.model: I think a small company is better, for two reasons. First, I can do many different kinds of work. For example, I can help with sales and planning. Second, it's easier to talk to the boss directly. So overall, I prefer a small company.

items.q: Should children start learning a second language at an early age? Why or why not?
items.model: I think starting early is better, for two reasons. First, young children learn pronunciation easily. For example, they can copy sounds very naturally. Second, they are not afraid of making mistakes. So overall, I prefer starting at an early age.

items.q: Is it better to exercise in the morning or in the evening? Why?
items.model: I think exercising in the morning is better, for two reasons. First, it gives me energy for the whole day. For example, I feel more awake at work after a run. Second, I don't have to worry about evening plans. So overall, I prefer morning exercise.

items.q: Should stores be open twenty-four hours a day? Why or why not?
items.model: I think twenty-four-hour stores are better, for two reasons. First, people who work at night can shop easily. For example, nurses can buy food after their shift. Second, they are helpful in emergencies. So overall, I prefer stores that are always open.

items.q: Is it better to rent a home or to buy one? Why?
items.model: I think renting is better, for two reasons. First, it's easier to move when my job changes. For example, I can move to a new city quickly. Second, I don't have to pay for big repairs. So overall, I prefer renting.

items.q: Should meetings be held online or in person? Why?
items.model: I think in-person meetings are better, for two reasons. First, it's easier to understand people's feelings. For example, I can see their faces and reactions. Second, it's easier to have quick, casual talks after the meeting. So overall, I prefer meeting in person.

items.q: Is it better to stay at one job for a long time or to change jobs often? Why?
items.model: I think changing jobs sometimes is better, for two reasons. First, I can learn new skills. For example, I can try sales and then marketing. Second, my salary may go up when I move. So overall, I prefer changing jobs when there's a good chance.

items.q: Should people take regular breaks from social media? Why or why not?
items.model: I think taking regular breaks is better, for two reasons. First, it reduces stress. For example, I don't compare myself with others as much. Second, I have more time for hobbies. So overall, I prefer taking breaks from social media.

items.q: Is it better to study alone or in a group? Why?
items.model: I think studying in a group is better, for two reasons. First, we can teach each other. For example, a friend can explain a difficult point. Second, it's easier to keep going when others are studying too. So overall, I prefer studying in a group.

items.q: Should cities build more bicycle lanes? Why or why not?
items.model: I think more bicycle lanes are better, for two reasons. First, cycling is good for people's health. For example, people can get exercise on their way to work. Second, it reduces traffic and pollution. So overall, I prefer more bicycle lanes.
